exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie back on a flat bench holding a dumbbell in each hand at chest level, palms facing forward.
Press both dumbbells straight up until your arms are fully extended, without locking out aggressively.
Lower the dumbbells slowly back to chest level, keeping your elbows at roughly a 45-degree angle from your torso.
Repeat for the desired number of reps, keeping your shoulder blades pinned to the bench throughout.

exercises.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
instructions: Sit on the floor with your upper back against a bench and a padded barbell rolled over your hips.
Plant your feet flat on the floor, knees bent, roughly shoulder-width apart.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to knees.
Pause at the top, then lower your hips back down with control before the next rep.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lying Pronation
instructions: Lie on a bench with your forearm supported and wrist hanging off the edge, holding a light dumbbell with your palm facing down.
Starting from a neutral wrist position, rotate your forearm to turn the dumbbell further into pronation (palm further downward).
Rotate back to the starting position with control.
Complete all reps on one arm before switching sides.

exercises.name: Clean and Jerk
instructions: Set up over the bar with feet hip-width apart and grip just outside your legs.
Pull the bar explosively from the floor, extending hips and knees to full triple extension, then pull yourself under the bar to catch it on your front shoulders in a front squat position (the clean).
Stand fully upright with the bar racked on your shoulders.
Dip slightly at the knees, then drive explosively upward, punching the bar overhead while splitting or squatting your feet to catch it with arms locked out (the jerk).
Recover both feet to a stable stance with the bar locked out overhead before lowering it back to the floor.

exercises.name: Sled Push
instructions: Load the sled with an appropriate weight and stand behind it, gripping the upright handles.
Lean forward from the ankles, keeping your back flat and core braced.
Drive through the balls of your feet with short, powerful steps to push the sled forward.
Continue for the target distance, maintaining a consistent low body angle throughout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Farmer's Walk
instructions: Stand between two heavy dumbbells, one on each side of your feet.
Hinge at the hips to grip both dumbbells, then stand up tall with your shoulders back and core braced.
Walk forward for the target distance in controlled, even steps, keeping the dumbbells close to your sides.
Set the dumbbells down with control at the end of the distance rather than dropping them.

exercises.name: Wall Ball Shot
instructions: Stand facing a wall, holding a medicine ball at chest height, feet shoulder-width apart.
Perform a full squat, keeping the ball close to your chest.
Drive up explosively out of the squat, extending your legs and hips, and throw the ball against a target on the wall above head height.
Catch the ball as it rebounds and immediately descend into the next rep.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a barbell at shoulder height with an overhand grip.
Brace your core and glutes so your ribcage stays stacked over your pelvis.
Press the bar straight overhead, moving your head back slightly to let the bar pass, then forward to lock out directly over your shoulders.
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control and repeat.

exercises.name: Turkish Get-Up
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell in one hand, arm locked out straight above your shoulder, same-side knee bent with foot flat on the floor.
Press the kettlebell up and roll onto your opposite forearm, then push up onto your hand.
Sweep your back leg through to a kneeling lunge position, keeping the kettlebell locked out overhead the whole time.
Stand up from the lunge, then reverse each step in order to return to the floor.
Complete all reps on one side before switching arms.
